tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /bla ma yang tig gi gsol 'debs bdud rtsi'i

sprin tshogs bzhugs so/ / āoṃ āḥhūṃ/ gdod ma'i mgon po kun bzang yab yum la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /rang byung sems nyid 'od gsal snying po'i don/ /da lta nyid du rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /lhun grub rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /rang gsal ye shes sgron me 'od po che/ /da lta nyid du mthong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /bde chen rgyal po rdo rje 'chang chen la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /'khor 'das gzhi grol sems nyid chos sku'i don/ /da lta nyid du rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /ye shes sgyu ma rdo rje sems dpa' la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ / mi 'gyur lhun grub bde chen 'og min du/ /da lta nyid du bgrod par byin gyis rlobs/ /dkyil 'khor mnga' bdag phyag na rdo rje la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /gsang sngags rgyal po tshe gcig sangs rgyas lam/ /da lta nyid du bgrod par byin gyis rlobs/ /rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul dga' rab rdo rje la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /rdos bcas phung po ye shes 'od lus su/ /da lta nyid du grol bar byin gyis brlobs/ /mkhyen rab sprul pa 'jam dpal bshes gnyen la/ / gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /las dang nyon mongs sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las/ /da lta nyid du sgrol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /blo mchog mnga' ba shṝ sidha la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /chos tshul rgya mtsho gsung rab nor bu'i gling*/ /da lta nyid du bgrod par byin gyis rlobs/ /dngos grub mchog brnyes dzñā na sū tra la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub yid bzhin sbyin/

/da lta nyid du 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /mkhas grub chen po bi ma mi tra la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /mngon gsum 'od gsal snang ba rnam pa bzhi/ /da lta nyid du 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /rang byung chen po padma 'byung gnas la/ / gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad ma lus pa/ /da lta nyid du zhi bar byin gyis brlobs/ /sems nyid dbang thob ting 'dzin bzang po la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /nyin mtshan gnyis med 'od gsal chen po'i ngang*/ /da lta nyid du 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /tshogs chen gnyis rdzogs chos rgyal khri srong la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gy-is gzigs/ / 'phags pa'i nor bdun yon tan rgyal srid mchog /da lta nyid du thob par byin gyis rlobs/ /thar gling snang byed ldang ma lhun rgyal la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /'gro kun phyam cig byang chub snying po'i sar/ /da lta nyid du bgrod par byin gyis rlobs/ /'od gsal lus grub seng ge dbang phyug la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /'khrul snang rang zad gdod ma'i gzhi dbyings su/ /da lta nyid du 'jug par byin gyis rlobs/ /lhun grub rgyal po rgyal ba zhang stong la/ / gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i don/ /da lta nyid du rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /gsung rab mdzod brnyes mkhas pa nyi 'bum la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /ye shes nyi mas ma rig mun pa'i tshogs/ /da lta nyid du sangs par byin gyis rlobs/ /dam chos rgyas mdzad gu ru jo 'ber la/ / gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /gzhan don rdzogs pa'i phrin las rlabs po che/

/da lta nyid du 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ / gzung 'dzin 'khrul zhig seng ge rgyab pa la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /'khor ba'i 'khrul snang tshe 'di'i zhen pa kun/ /da lta nyid du zad par byin gyis rlobs/ /dngos grub mchog brnyes grub chen me long la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /don gnyis lhun grub 'od gsal chos nyid ngang*/ /da lta nyid du phyin par byin gyis rlobs/ /rig 'dzin chen po ku ma rā dza la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /rtogs pa'i 'od 'bar thugs rje'i sprin phung mchog /da lta nyid du 'char bar byin gyis rlobs/ /'od gsal sgyu ma sna tshogs rang grol la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /snang srid snod bcud rmi lam sgyu ma ru/ /da lta nyid du 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ brgyud pa'i kha bskang ni/ mkhas grub chen po'i bde legs rgya mtsho la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gy-is gzigs/ /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems mchog 'di/ /da lta nyid du 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs/ /mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug bya bral chos rje la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i bstan pa 'di/ / da lta nyid du rgyas par byin gyis rlobs/ /bya btang chen po sangs rgyas bkra shis la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /snying po med pa tshe 'di'i bya ba kun/ /da lta nyid du thong bar byin gyis rlobs/ /kun spangs chen po gu ṇa shrī la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /'khor 'das chos kun thig le nyag gcig tu/ /da lta nyid du rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /'gro ba'i mgon po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /dbyings rig dbyer med 'od gsal chos sku'i don/

/da lta nyid du rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ 'di yan chad padma nor bu'i phyag dpe la 'dug pas bris so/ / bi ma'i rnam sprul sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /chos kun mnyam nyid 'od gsal klong yangs su/ /da lta nyid du grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rig 'dzin chen po kun dga' dpal bzang la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /gzung 'dzin 'khrul rtog gdod ma'i mkha' dbyings su/ /da lta nyid du dag par byin gyis rlobs/ /rgyal ba kun 'dus rje btsun ratna la/ / gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /snang bzhi mthar phyin ye shes 'od kyi lus/ /da lta nyid du 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /sku gsum mngon gyur prañdzā'i mtshan can la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /don dam gshis lugs dpyid kyi yon tan de/ /da lta nyid du thob par byin gyis rlobs/ / brgyud pa'i khyad par gcig ni/ rje btsun chen po bya bral chos rje la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /sgo gsum bya bral ka dag pho brang du/ /da lta nyid du phyin par byin gyis rlobs/ / 'gro ba skyob mdzad gzhan phan rdo rje la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /'gro drug 'khor ba'i g.yang sa chen po las/ /da lta nyid du thar bar byin gyis rlobs/ /mthu stobs mnga' bdag nam mkha' rdo rje la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /las nyon gzung 'dzin 'khor ba'i 'khrul snang kun/ /da lta nyid du zhig par byin gyis rlobs/ /chos nyid mngon gyur 'od gsal klong yangs la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /gnyis su 'dzin pa'i bag chags yul snang las/ /da lta nyid du grol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /rdzogs chen rnal 'byor bsod nams rin chen la/

/gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /blo dang chos zad rdzogs pa chen po la/ /da lta nyid du rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /bya khyung ngag dbang padma rnam rgyal la/ / gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /kun tu bzang po ma bcos dgongs pa'i klong*/ /da lta nyid du rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ / thugs rje'i mnga' bdag bsod nams dbang po la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /smin grol rnam gnyis mthar phyin dgongs pa mchog /da lta nyid du rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /bi ma'i rnam 'phrul nam mkha' 'jigs med la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /'od gsal theg mchog rdo rje snying po'i klong*/ /da lta nyid du rdol bar byin gyis rlobs/ /mkhas grub mthar phyin klong rdzogs mtha' bral la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /chos nyid klong gis phrin las rab 'byams kun/ /da lta nyid du 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ /grub thob chen po padma rig 'dzin la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /'od gsal lhun grub gdod ma'i gzhi dbyings su/ /da lta nyid du phyin par byin gyis rlobs/ / 'di yan chad nyi ma grags pas mdzad/ / bsam gtan mkhan po nam mkha' 'od gsal la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /bag chags bcas pa'i sgrib gnyis mun pa'i tshogs/ /da lta nyid du sangs par byin gy-is rlobs/ /mkhas grub chen po padma rnam rgyal la/ /gsol ba 'degs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ / sde gsum klong dgu man ngag snying po'i don/ /da lta nyid du rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /bshes gnyen dam pa skal bzang mtshan can la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /'gro kun yang dag thar pa'i gling mchog der/ /da lta nyid du 'dren par byin gyis rlobs/

/rdo rje 'dzin pa bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /'ching grol med pa chos nyid zab mo'i don/ /da lta nyid du 'byor bar byin gyis rlobs/ / tshigs bcad gsum nyi sprul rin po ches mdzad/ rgyal kun spyi gzugs nges don bstan 'dzin la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /zab gsal gnyis med mkha' khyab ye shes dbyings/ /da lta nyid du rtogs par byin gyis rlobs/ /rigs brgya'i khyab bdag kun bzang gzhan phan la/ /gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs/ /gzhom gzhig dang bral 'ja' lus 'pho ba che/ /da lta nyid du 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ / shlau ka gnyis ngag dbang blo gros kyis kha skong bgyis pa yin/ gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas/ /nyan thos rang rgyal 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams dang*/ /chos mdzad yongs la gus pas gsol ba 'debs/ /thugs rjes gzigs la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /kye ma kyi hud nyam thag bdag lta bu/ /las dang nyon mongs bzod dkas yun ring mnar/ /'di la khyed kyis thugs rje'i phyag rkyong la/ /da lta nyid du drang bar mdzad du gsol/ /ngang nyid ye nas sangs rgyas yin mod kyang*/ /ma rig dbang gis srid pa 'dir 'khyams te/ /rmi lam lta bu'i 'khrul 'khor nyam re thag /'di la skyabs dang skyob pa mdzad du gsol/ /bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyi/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho mtha' med brgal dka' bar/ /ye shes gru chen bla na med pa yis/ /sdug bsngal chu ba ོ sgrol bar mdzad du gsol/ / yun ring dus nas goms pa'i bag chags gzugs/ /'khrul snang gzung 'dzin ri rgyal lhun mtho ba/ /rnam grol mchog gi ye shes rdo rje yis/ /da lta nyid du gzhig par mdzad du gsol/ /ma rig mun pa shin tu 'thibs po che/ /rgyun ring brtag dka' pha mtha' mi mngon zhing*/ /'od gsal snying po'i sgrib pa rlabs chen 'di/

/ye shes zer gyis bsal bar mdzad du gsol/ /ji tsam 'bad kyang nyon mongs sdug bsngal rgyu/ /snying po med pa'i 'jig rten bya ba las/ /bdag gi yid 'di rab tu bzlog nas kyang*/ /nyin mtshan chos kyis 'da' bar mdzad du gsol/ /tshul min yid byed chu rlabs gnyer 'dra zhing*/ /kun rtog sna tshogs yul lnga'i rjes su 'brang*/ /tshogs brgyad bag chags kun gzhi bcas pa kun/ /chos kyi dbyings su zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /rtog bcas bag chags 'dod pa'i sems nyon mongs/ /gsal ba gzugs dang mi rtog gzugs med kyi/ /srid pa'i sems gang bag chags rjes 'brangs pa/ /de dag thams cad dag par mdzad du gsol/ /rang don sgoms pa lhur len dman pa'i blo/ /gcig pur zhi ba gnyer las ldog nas kyang*/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i chos mchog lam zhugs te/ /rlabs chen gzhan don 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /lam gol lam log dman pa'i 'gro kun gyi/ /las dang nyon mongs bag chags rab sbyangs te/ /sems nyid yid bzhin thar pa'i grong khyer du/ /ma lus phyam cig bgrod par mdzad du gsol/ /sgrib pa'i rgya mtsho shin tu rnyog pa can/ /dus ring thog mtha' med nas nyer gnas kyang*/ /bdag cag mthu yis thar pa'i skabs med pas/ /brtse chen khyed kyis drang bar mdzad du gsol/ /shugs drag bzod par dka' ba'i sems nyon mongs/ /sdug bsngal mang ldan srid pa'i zug rngu ldang*/ /bag med gzhan dbang le lo'i 'jigs pa las/ /de ring nyid nas nges par bskyab tu gsol/ /snying nas snying po med pa'i chos rnams la/ /mi rtag mi brtan sgyu ma'i bslu brid du/ /nges par rtogs nas nges 'byung skyo shas kyis/ /nyin mtshan kun tu 'da' bar mdzad du gsol/ /'phags pa'i ri ngogs dben zhing nyams dga' bar/ /rig dang mngon shes ting 'dzin 'grub gyur nas/ /don gnyis lhun grub bde chen mkha' dbyings su/ / tshe 'di nyid la phyin par mdzad du gsol/

/gcig pur bsran tshugs sgrub la brtson pa dang*/ /tshe 'di'i phyogs su skad cig mi yengs shing*/ /gong ma'i rjes snyogs dngos grub mthar phyin nas/ /rtag tu bla ma mnyes par mdzad du gsol/ /dam tshig sdom pa nyams chag med pa dang*/ /lta sgom spyod 'bras ma nor don rtogs nas/ /nyin mtshan 'od gsal ngang las mi g.yo zhing*/ /rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /snang srid rnam dag bskyed rdzogs mthar phyin nas/ /mkha' 'gro dam can sprin bzhin 'thibs nas kyang*/ /dngos grub rnam gnyis char bzhin 'bab pa dang*/ /phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ /dag snang mos gus phyogs med 'char ba dang*/ /byams dang snying rje rgyun chad med pa dang*/ /lta sgom nyams rtogs yon tan 'bar ba dang*/ /'gro don phyogs med 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ / bdag gis mos dge phun tshogs 'di yis ni/ /'gro kun ma lus phyam cig yongs grol nas/ /bde chen lhun grub kun tu bzang po'i zhing*/ /tshe 'di nyid la phyin par mdzad du gsol/ /tshul 'di bla ma dam pa rnams la mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob cing mang du thos pa'i nor gyis phyug pa'i theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa klong chen rab 'byams kyis/ rang byung padma'i bzhugs gnas lha ring brag tu sbyar nas gsol ba btab pa'o/ /phyogs dus gnas skabs thams cad du bkra shis par gyur cig
/dge'o/ /dge'o/ /dge'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ klong chen rab 'byams kyi gsung 'bum/ (9)bla ma yang tig gi gsol 'debs bdud rtsi'i sprin tshogs/ - PAGE 62 -- PAGE 61 -- PAGE 53 -
